title: China reunification is an inevitable historical trend
description: Recently, the world's attention has been focused on the East. At the invitation of President Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, US President Donald Trump paid a state visit to China from May 13 to 15. These two major events have once again brought global focus to an important issue -- the Taiwan issue.

title: Signs emerge on how APEC host China could handle Taiwan’s participation, but hardest test is yet to come
description: China kept the Taiwan issue largely out of sight during last week’s APEC meeting in Suzhou, but analysts say the leader’s summit in Shenzhen this November could prove harder to manage.

title: Global Times- 'When I stand there, I am not only representing myself': Chinese soldier who held ground with composure in front of Air Force One speaks in an exclusive interview with the Global Times
description: Global Times: PLA guard Liu Zhencheng goes viral as China diplomacy rises, showcasing discipline and major-country image.

title: Trump Holds Taiwan Defense Cards Close to War Chest
description: China's communist regime considers democratically governed Taiwan to be a Chinese province, demanding that countries adhere to its one-China principle under which it claims sovereignty over the island.

title: Decisive Moves: World News Recap from Tragic Incidents to Strategic Diplomacies
description: This summary of world news covers significant events including a deadly train crash in Belgium, political shifts in Senegal and Ukraine, military disputes involving the U.S., and notable international sanctions and agreements. Key topics feature the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, Taiwan-China tensions, and economic strategies in Ireland and Russia.

title: ‘Don’t kowtow to Beijing’: Michael Chong on his Taiwan trip
description: Is our new trade agreement with China limiting Canada's willingness to take a stand against Beijing's imperialism?

title: Taiwan tracks second Chinese ’combat’ patrol in a week, sends ships and jets to monitor
description: China has ‌pressured Taiwan ‌by increasing its military presence around the island, and Taipei is on high alert ​following a summit between the U.S. and Chinese leaders.

title: China, Singapore top diplomats reaffirm commitment to Malacca Strait transit rights
description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi tells counterpart that keeping the critical shipping lane open is ‘a shared aspiration of all countries’.

title: ‘One Way Or The Other’: Marco Rubio Says Strait Of Hormuz Has To Be Open
description: Marco Rubio said that no country, including Russia and China, support Iran’s idea of charging ships money to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Quad foreign ministers hold talks in New Delhi on Indo-Pacific cooperation
description: Foreign ministers from the Quad countries of Australia, India, Japan, and the United States are meeting in New Delhi to strengthen cooperation in the Indo-Pacific and their concern over China’s growing influence in the region. India’s foreign ministry says the ministers will on Monday discuss recent developments in the Indo-Pacific and ways to advance cooperation among their nations. The leaders are also expected to discuss the Iran war and halted energy shipments through the Strait of Hormuz. The meeting comes days after U.S. President Donald Trump visited China, a trip closely watched in New Delhi for signs of any shift in Washington’s approach toward Beijing.
